questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Grandfather joins an evening language class because he wants to speak with a new neighbour. At first, he often makes mistakes when choosing the endings of words. His teacher gives him short conversations to practise rather than long lists to memorise. Over the next month, he begins to make progress and needs fewer pauses. He can ask about the neighbour's garden and understand a simple reply. Some words still puzzle him, so he writes questions for his next lesson. He says that being understood matters more to him than sounding perfect immediately." This supports the answer: "A learner improves through useful practice despite errors".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：爷爷参加晚间语言课，因为想和一位新邻居交流。 起初，他选择词尾时常常犯错。 老师给他短对话练习，而不是让他背长单子。 接下来一个月，他开始取得进步，停顿少了。 他能问邻居花园的事，也能听懂简单回答。 有些词仍让他困惑，他便写下问题，留待下次课。 他说，对他而言，被听懂比立刻说得完美更重要。 因此正确选项为“A learner improves through useful practice despite errors”。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A Careful Record Protects a Little Book Box”. Evidence: Before a storm, our library group helps prepare the small outdoor book box. I note down the titles of books we move into the main building. Another volunteer checks the box roof for gaps where water could enter. We make sure that the empty box is firmly shut before leaving. The next morning, fallen leaves cover the path, but the inside of the box is dry. Using our list, we put every book back in its original section. The careful record makes the work quick and prevents anyone from searching for missing books.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A Careful Record Protects a Little Book Box”。原文依据：暴风雨前，我们图书馆小组帮忙整理室外小书箱。 我记下搬进主楼的书名。 另一位志愿者检查箱顶是否有进水的缝隙。 离开前，我们确保空书箱已经关牢。 第二天早上，落叶覆盖小路，但箱内是干的。 我们照着清单，把每本书放回原来的区域。 细致的记录让工作迅速，也避免大家去寻找并未丢失的书。
